# `nlink-lab use`

## Reference

<!-- cli-ref:start (generated by `nlink-lab docs-gen`; do not edit) -->

```text
Select the current lab: the one lab-scoped commands act on.

A command's lab is `-L LAB` when given, else `$NLINK_LAB`, else the lab `use` selected (per user, `sudo` included), else the only running lab. Without LAB, prints the current lab and where it comes from; `--clear` forgets it.

JSON OUTPUT: { "schema_version": 1, "lab": str | null, "from": "flag" | "env" | "context" | "only" | null, "note"?: str }

Usage: nlink-lab use [OPTIONS] [LAB]

Arguments:
  [LAB]
          The lab to make current. Without it, show the current lab and where it comes from

Options:
      --clear
          Forget the current lab

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
```

<!-- cli-ref:end -->
